work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act grants the conclavists of the 1831 conclave familiar status, citizenship, pension and testamentary privileges; signed Fiat motu proprio M. and followed by its own printed list of conclavists (LF12592–13017). Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF12238; own dating clause LF12588–12589 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum decimo kalendas ianuarii anno primo.. Own provenance note LF12311 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
